name: – Pasquale Tridico – After § 63 – Am 2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2024
part_text: 63 a. Calls for an immediate investigation into the Commission’s use of public funds to finance a shadow lobby group promoting its own green policies; stresses that lobbying should be transparent, with full disclosure of all parties involved;
